summary: This declares an interface named TemperatureSensor: a contract saying that any temperature sensor must be able to report a current temperature as a whole number. Tests can supply a fake sensor that satisfies this contract, so the thermostat code can be checked without real hardware.

lines.text: An interface lists what a type must be able to do without saying how it does it. Code that depends on TemperatureSensor works equally well with a real hardware sensor or a stand-in used during testing.
This is the single method every sensor must provide, declared with a semicolon instead of a body because the implementing class supplies the actual reading.
